rules.statement: A certificate of no claim is a registrable instrument and should be considered in determining the priority of land titles.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, a certificate of no claim is a registrable instrument. Section 6 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance says that in Chapter III. of that Ordinance instrument means instrument affecting land, unless the context otherwise requires. Section 8 enumerates instruments that shall be deemed to affect land, and among the enumerated classes are" deeds or other instruments for establishing or transferring any security, interest or encumbrance affecting any land (other than a lease at will, or for any period not exceeding one month)"."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 6 of the Registration of Documents Ordinance and Section 8 of the Encroachments upon Crown Lands Ordinance (Cap. 231)
